API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APICloud Nanolog Streaming Service (NSS)NSS Feeds Resource Get Feed Out Put Formats
NSS Feeds Resource Get Feed Out Put Formats
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/nssFeeds/feedOutputDefaults

Retrieves the default cloud NSS feed output format for different log types

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
type
string

Possible values: [ADMIN_AUDIT, WEBLOG, ALERT, FWLOG, DNSLOG, MULTIFEEDLOG, CASB_FILELOG, CASB_MAILLOG, ECLOG, EC_DNSLOG, CASB_ITSM, CASB_CRM, CASB_CODE_REPO, CASB_COLLAB, CASB_PCS, USER_ACT_REP, USER_COUNT_ALERT, USER_IMP_TRAVEL_ALERT, ENDPOINT_DLP, EC_EVENTLOG, EMAIL_DLP]

The type of logs that you are streaming

Default value: WEBLOG
multiFeedType
string

Possible values: [ANY, NONE, WEB, FW, DNS, EMAIL, NSSALERTS, BW, CSTAT, TUNNEL, CASB, EC_SESS, EC_DNS, USER_ACT_REP, USER_ACT_ALERT, USER_APP_STATE, NSS_ADMIN_AUDIT, ENDPOINT_DLP, EC_METRICS, EC_EVENT, EMAIL_DLP, ZPA_USER_ACT_LOG, ZPA_EVENT_LOG, ZPA_APP_PROTECTION_LOG, ZPA_APP_CONNECTOR_STATUS_LOG, ZPA_ZEN_STATUS_LOG, ZPA_USER_STATUS_LOG, EXTRANET_SESS]

This field is used to set the multi-feed type to Tunnel

Default value: TUNNEL
fieldFormat
string

Possible values: [QRADAR, CSV, TAB_SEPARATED, SPLUNK_CIM, ARCSIGHT_CEF, SYMANTEC_MSS, LOGRHYTHM, NAME_VALUE_PAIRS, RSA_SECURITY, JSON]

The feed output type of your SIEM

Default value: CSV
Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
property name*
